summary: No code repository was found for this DAC 2025 paper itself. The paper does not include a code availability statement, and the authors' personal pages (satvikmaurya.github.io, metalcyanide.github.io) list only PDF and BibTeX links for this paper. The HERQULES baseline repo (satvikmaurya/HERQULES) was identified as a third-party repo that the paper builds on and evaluates against; it contains Python/Jupyter code with no HLS designs. The paper uses hls4ml for HLS synthesis but does not release its own HLS designs.
